title: Madhya-khanda, part 9 (portion 32)
html:
The section "Wondrous Pastimes of Mahaprabhu in the Bhava of Bhagavan" (end): a brahmana takes the dust of the Lord's feet, and the Lord leaps into the Ganga; Nityananda brings Him out onto the bank; the Lord goes off to the northern bank and returns at the devotees' entreaties; in Srivasa's house — words on serving Krishna and on His departure; Murari, embraced by the Lord, recites the verse of Sudama; the Lord reveals His radiance, and Srivasa bathes Him; the Lord and the devotees clean the temple; Lochana Dasa calls on all to serve Gaura. The section "The Leper's Release from Sin and the Bhava of Baladeva": a leper who had offended Srivasa begs the Lord for deliverance; the Lord rejects him and delivers him only when Srivasa forgives

Refrain: "Who does not weep at the qualities of my Gauranga? He has bound the minds of all living beings with prema"

আর অপরূপ শুন তার পরদিনে ।
বান্ধব সহিত প্রভু নৃত্য-অবসানে ॥ ৬৪ ॥

āra aparūpa śuna tāra paradine |
bāndhaba sahita prabhu nṛtya-abasāne || 64 ||

ara aparupa shuna — hear another wonder; tara paradine — on the next day; bandhava sahita — with His kinsmen; prabhu nritya-avasane — at the end of the Lord's dance

64Hear one more wonder — on the next day,
when the dancing with His own had ended,

ভূমিতে পড়িয়া প্রভু দণ্ডবৎ করে ।
আনন্দে সকল লোক হরি হরি বোলে ॥ ৬৫ ॥

bhūmite paṛiẏā prabhu daṇḍabat kare |
ānande sakala loka hari hari bole || 65 ||

bhumite padiya — falling on the ground; prabhu dandavat kare — the Lord lies flat like a rod; anande sakala loka — all people in joy; hari hari bole — cry "Hari, Hari"

65the Lord fell flat on the ground like a rod,
and all the people in joy cry: "Hari, Hari!"

হেনই সময় এক ব্রাহ্মণ আসিয়া ।
প্রভু-পদাম্বুজ-ধূলি লইল হাসিয়া ॥ ৬৬ ॥

henai samaẏa eka brāhmaṇa āsiẏā |
prabhu-padāmbuja-dhūli laila hāsiẏā || 66 ||

henai samaya — at that very time; eka brahmana asiya — a brahmana coming; prabhu-padambuja-dhuli — the dust of the Lord's lotus feet; laila hasiya — took, smiling

66At that very moment a certain brahmana came up1
and, smiling, took the dust of the Lord's lotus feet.

দেখি' গৌর ভগবান্ সত্বরে উঠিলা ।
ব্রাহ্মণ-চরিত দেখি' দুঃখিত হইলা ॥ ৬৭ ॥

dekhi' gaura bhagabān satbare uṭhilā |
brāhmaṇa-carita dekhi' duḥkhita hailā || 67 ||

dekhi — seeing; gaura bhagavan — Gaura Bhagavan; satvare uthila — rose quickly; brahmana-charita dekhi — seeing the brahmana's deed; duhkhita haila — became grieved

67Seeing this, Gaura Bhagavan quickly rose:
seeing the brahmana's deed, He was grieved.

মহা-অনুতাপ করি' বিরস-বদন ।
অসন্তোষে নাসিকায় নিঃশ্বাস সঘন ॥ ৬৮ ॥

mahā-anutāpa kari' birasa-badana |
asantoṣe nāsikāẏa niḥśbāsa saghana || 68 ||

maha-anutapa kari — in great remorse; virasa-vadana — with a downcast face; asantoshe — in displeasure; nasikaya nihshvasa saghana — breathing heavily through the nose

68In great remorse, His face downcast,
in displeasure He breathes heavily and fast.

সত্বর উঠিয়া প্রভু ধাইল আচম্বিতে ।
জাহ্নবীর জলে ঝাঁপ দিলেন তুরিতে ॥ ৬৯ ॥

satbara uṭhiẏā prabhu dhāila ācambite |
jāhnabīra jale jhāṁpa dilena turite || 69 ||

satvara uthiya — rising quickly; prabhu dhaila achambite — the Lord suddenly ran; jahnavira jale — into the waters of the Jahnavi; jhampa dilena turite — swiftly leapt

69Quickly rising, the Lord suddenly ran
and swiftly leapt into the waters of the Jahnavi.

জলে মগ্ন হৈল প্রভু না পাই দেখিতে ।
সব নিজজন ঝাঁপ দিল পাছে তাথে ॥ ৭০ ॥

jale magna haila prabhu nā pāi dekhite |
saba nijajana jhāṁpa dila pāche tāthe || 70 ||

jale magna haila prabhu — the Lord sank into the water; na pai dekhite — He cannot be seen; saba nijajana — all His own; jhampa dila pachhe tathe — leapt in after Him

70The Lord sank under the water — He cannot be seen;
all His own leapt in after Him.

নদিয়ার লোক সব গণিল প্রমাদ ।
কান্দয়ে সকল লোক করয়ে বিষাদ ॥ ৭১ ॥

nadiẏāra loka saba gaṇila pramāda |
kāndaẏe sakala loka karaẏe biṣāda || 71 ||

nadiyara loka saba — all the people of Nadia; ganila pramada — reckoned it a calamity; kandaye sakala loka — all the people weep; karaye vishada — they grieve

71All the people of Nadia thought a calamity had happened:
all weep, all are in sorrow.

পুত্র পুত্র করি' ধায় শচী তার মাতা ।
ঝাঁপ দিতে চাহে বিশ্বম্ভর হরি যথা ॥ ৭২ ॥

putra putra kari' dhāẏa śacī tāra mātā |
jhāṁpa dite cāhe biśbambhara hari yathā || 72 ||

putra putra kari — crying "son, son"; dhaya shachi tara mata — runs Shachi, His mother; jhampa dite chahe — wants to leap; vishvambhara hari yatha — where Vishvambhara Hari is

72Crying "My son! My son!" runs Shachi, His mother,
wanting to leap in where Vishvambhara Hari is.

উন্মতী পাগলী শচী কান্দে উভরায় ।
হাকান্দ কান্দনা কান্দে ভূমিতে লোটায় ॥ ৭৩ ॥

unmatī pāgalī śacī kānde ubharāẏa |
hākānda kāndanā kānde bhūmite loṭāẏa || 73 ||

unmati pagali shachi — Shachi, distraught and beside herself; kande ubharaya — wails aloud; hakanda kandana kande — sobs and sobs; bhumite lotaya — rolls on the ground

73Shachi, distraught, wails aloud,
weeps and sobs, rolls on the ground.

এছন প্রমাদ দেখি' অবধূতরায় ।
প্রভুর উদ্দেশে ঝাঁপ দিলেন গঙ্গায় ॥ ৭৪ ॥

echana pramāda dekhi' abadhūtarāẏa |
prabhura uddeśe jhāṁpa dilena gaṅgāẏa || 74 ||

echhana pramada dekhi — seeing such calamity; avadhuta-raya — the Avadhuta-raya; prabhura uddeshe — in search of the Lord; jhampa dilena gangaya — leapt into the Ganga

74Seeing such calamity, the Avadhuta-raya
leapt into the Ganga in search of the Lord.

জলে মগ্ন হৈয়া প্রভুর ধরিলেন হাথে ।
ধরিয়া তুলিল গঙ্গাকূলে আচম্বিতে ॥ ৭৫ ॥

jale magna haiẏā prabhura dharilena hāthe |
dhariẏā tulila gaṅgākūle ācambite || 75 ||

jale magna haiya — diving into the water; prabhura dharilena hathe — He caught the Lord by the hand; dhariya tulila — holding, He lifted [Him]; ganga-kule achambite — suddenly onto the bank of the Ganga

75Diving into the water, He caught the Lord by the hand
and, holding Him, suddenly brought Him out onto the bank of the Ganga.

দেখিয়া সকল লোক অতি আনন্দিত ।
সব নিজজন কান্দে পাইয়া সম্বিত ॥ ৭৬ ॥

dekhiẏā sakala loka ati ānandita |
saba nijajana kānde pāiẏā sambita || 76 ||

dekhiya sakala loka — seeing this, all the people; ati anandita — were overjoyed; saba nijajana kande — all His own weep; paiya samvita — regaining their senses

76Seeing this, all the people were overjoyed;
all [the Lord's] own, coming to their senses, weep.

শচীদেবী কান্দে কোলে করি' বিশ্বম্ভর ।
শ্রীবাস মুরারি মুকুন্দ শুক্লাম্বর ॥ ৭৭ ॥

śacīdebī kānde kole kari' biśbambhara |
śrībāsa murāri mukunda śuklāmbara || 77 ||

shachi-devi kande — Shachi-devi weeps; kole kari vishvambhara — holding Vishvambhara in her arms; shrivasa murari mukunda shuklambara — Srivasa, Murari, Mukunda, Shuklambara

77Shachi-devi weeps, holding Vishvambhara in her arms;
[weep] Srivasa, Murari, Mukunda, Shuklambara,

গদাধর নরহরি কান্দে পদ ধরি' ।
বাসুদেব জগদানন্দ কান্দে মুখ হেরি' ॥ ৭৭+১ ॥

gadādhara narahari kānde pada dhari' |
bāsudeba jagadānanda kānde mukha heri' || 77+1 ||

gadadhara narahari — Gadadhara and Narahari; kande pada dhari — weep, clasping the feet; vasudeva jagadananda — Vasudeva and Jagadananda; kande mukha heri — weep, gazing at the face

77+1Gadadhara and Narahari weep, clasping [His] feet,
Vasudeva and Jagadananda weep, gazing at [His] face2,

হরিদাস-আদি যত যত নিজজন ।
গৌরমুখ দেখি' কান্দে তরাসিত মন ॥ ৭৮ ॥

haridāsa-ādi yata yata nijajana |
gauramukha dekhi' kānde tarāsita mana || 78 ||

haridasa-adi — Haridasa and others; yata yata nijajana — all, all His own; gaura-mukha dekhi — looking at Gaura's face; kande tarasita mana — weep with frightened hearts

78Haridasa and all, all His own —
they weep as they look at Gaura's face, still shaken with fear.

আর সব জন দুঃখ পাঞাছে বিস্তর ।
গৌরমুখ দেখি' সুখে সভে গেলা ঘর ॥ ৭৯ ॥

āra saba jana duḥkha pāñāche bistara |
gauramukha dekhi' sukhe sabhe gelā ghara || 79 ||

ara saba jana — all the other people; duhkha pannachhe vistara — had suffered much grief; gaura-mukha dekhi — seeing Gaura's face; sukhe sabhe gela ghara — all went home happy

79All the other people, who had grieved greatly,
seeing Gaura's face, went home happy.

তবে সবজন মিলি' প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ।
মুরারিগুপ্তের ঘর গেলা ত সত্বর ॥ ৮০ ॥

tabe sabajana mili' prabhu biśbambhara |
murāriguptera ghara gelā ta satbara || 80 ||

tabe — then; sabajana mili — together with all; prabhu vishvambhara — the Lord Vishvambhara; murari-guptera ghara — to the house of Murari Gupta; gela ta satvara — went quickly

80Then the Lord Vishvambhara, with everyone,
quickly went to the house of Murari Gupta.

ক্ষণেক থাকিয়া প্রভু চলিলা তুরিতে ।
বিজয়-মিশ্রের ঘর গেলা আচম্বিতে ॥ ৮১ ॥

kṣaṇeka thākiẏā prabhu calilā turite |
bijaẏa-miśrera ghara gelā ācambite || 81 ||

kshaneka thakiya — staying a little while; prabhu chalila turite — the Lord left quickly; vijaya-mishrera ghara — to the house of Vijaya Mishra; gela achambite — went unexpectedly

81After staying there a little, the Lord swiftly left
and unexpectedly came to the house of Vijaya Mishra.3

রজনী বঞ্চিয়া প্রভু উঠিলা প্রভাতে ।
গঙ্গার উত্তর-কূলে গেলা আচম্বিতে ॥ ৮২ ॥

rajanī bañciẏā prabhu uṭhilā prabhāte |
gaṅgāra uttara-kūle gelā ācambite || 82 ||

rajani vanchiya — having spent the night; prabhu uthila prabhate — the Lord rose at dawn; gangara uttara-kule — to the northern bank of the Ganga; gela achambite — went unexpectedly

82Having spent the night, the Lord rose at dawn
and unexpectedly went to the northern bank of the Ganga.

ভ্রমণ করয়ে তার না বুঝিয়ে মন ।
তরাস পাইলা সঙ্গে ছিলা যত জন ॥ ৮৩ ॥

bhramaṇa karaẏe tāra nā bujhiẏe mana |
tarāsa pāilā saṅge chilā yata jana || 83 ||

bhramana karaye — He wanders; tara na bujhiye mana — His mind cannot be understood; tarasa paila — were frightened; sange chhila yata jana — all who were with Him

83He wanders there — His mind is past understanding;
all who were with Him were frightened.

ব্রাহ্মণ-সজ্জন আর যত নিজজন ।
সভে মিলি' নিবেদিল বিনয়-বচন ॥ ৮৪ ॥

brāhmaṇa-sajjana āra yata nijajana |
sabhe mili' nibedila binaẏa-bacana || 84 ||

brahmana-sajjana — brahmanas and good people; ara yata nijajana — and all His own; sabhe mili — all together; nivedila vinaya-vachana — submitted humble words

84The brahmanas, the good people and all His own
together made a humble plea to Him:

প্রসন্ন হও প্রভু গৌরগুণনিধি ।
কাতরে কহয়ে এই সব অপরাধী ॥ ৮৫ ॥

prasanna hao prabhu gauraguṇanidhi |
kātare kahaẏe ei saba aparādhī || 85 ||

prasanna hao — be gracious; prabhu gaura-guna-nidhi — Lord Gaura, treasury of virtues; katare kahaye — say in anguish; ei saba aparadhi — all these offenders

85"Be gracious, Lord Gaura, treasury of virtues!" —
so all these offenders say in anguish. —

কৃপা কর মহাপ্রভু ছাড় অতি রোষ ।
এমন কতেক নিবে সেবকের দোষ ॥ ৮৬ ॥

kṛpā kara mahāprabhu chāṛa ati roṣa |
emana kateka nibe sebakera doṣa || 86 ||

kripa kara mahaprabhu — have mercy, Mahaprabhu; chhada ati rosha — give up great anger; emana kateka nibe — how many such will You take [to heart]; sevakera dosha — faults of servants

86"Have mercy, Mahaprabhu, give up Your great anger:
how many such faults of Your servants will You hold against them?

করুণাসাগর প্রভু করুণাবিগ্রহ ।
করুণায় অবতার লোক-অনুগ্রহ ॥ ৮৭ ॥

karuṇāsāgara prabhu karuṇābigraha |
karuṇāẏa abatāra loka-anugraha || 87 ||

karuna-sagara prabhu — the Lord, the ocean of mercy; karuna-vigraha — mercy embodied; karunaya avatara — descended out of mercy; loka-anugraha — in grace to the people

87The Lord is an ocean of mercy, mercy embodied;
You descended out of mercy, in grace towards the people.

এমন বিমুখ কেনে হও ত আপনে ।
আমরা কি জানি তোর চিত-আচরণে ॥ ৮৮ ॥

emana bimukha kene hao ta āpane |
āmarā ki jāni tora cita-ācaraṇe || 88 ||

emana vimukha — so averse; kene hao ta apane — why have You Yourself become; amara ki jani — how can we know; tora chita-acharane — Your heart and ways

88Why have You Yourself so turned away [from us]?
How can we know what is in Your heart, what Your ways are?

ঘরেরে আইস প্রভু ঘুচাহ প্রমাদ ।
নিজ অনুগত দেখি' করহ প্রসাদ ॥ ৮৯ ॥

gharere āisa prabhu ghucāha pramāda |
nija anugata dekhi' karaha prasāda || 89 ||

gharere aisa prabhu — come home, Lord; ghuchaha pramada — remove this calamity; nija anugata dekhi — looking on Your followers; karaha prasada — show grace

89Come home, Lord, avert this calamity;
look upon Your followers — be gracious!"

এতেক বিনয় যবে কৈল নিজজনে ।
সদয়-হৃদয় প্রভু দ্রবিলা তখনে ॥ ৯০ ॥

eteka binaẏa yabe kaila nijajane |
sadaẏa-hṛdaẏa prabhu drabilā takhane || 90 ||

eteka vinaya — such humble entreaty; yabe kaila nijajane — when His own made; sadaya-hridaya prabhu — the Lord of compassionate heart; dravila takhane — then melted

90When His own thus humbly pleaded,
the Lord's compassionate heart then melted.

ঘরেরে আইলা প্রভু আনন্দিত-মনে ।
নিজগুণ গায় নিজ-অনুগত-সনে ॥ ৯১ ॥

gharere āilā prabhu ānandita-mane |
nijaguṇa gāẏa nija-anugata-sane || 91 ||

gharere aila prabhu — the Lord came home; anandita-mane — with a joyful heart; nija-guna gaya — sings His own qualities; nija-anugata-sane — with His followers

91The Lord returned home with a joyful heart
and with His followers sings of His own qualities.

নদিয়া-নগরে ভেল আনন্দ-উল্লাস ।
গোরাগুণ গায় সুখে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৯২ ॥

nadiẏā-nagare bhela ānanda-ullāsa |
gorāguṇa gāẏa sukhe e locanadāsa || 92 ||

nadiya-nagare — in the town of Nadia; bhela ananda-ullasa — there arose jubilation; gora-guna gaya sukhe — happily sings Gora's qualities; e lochana-dasa — this Lochana Dasa

92In the town of Nadia there arose jubilation —
Lochana Dasa happily sings of Gora's qualities.

Raga varadi; disha: "Haya re haya, are haya!" (murchha); refrain: "I take upon myself all misfortunes of Gora's beauty! He has given away the treasure of prema, filling the world with it"

শোক ছাড়ি' হৃষ্টমনে তবে গৌরহরি ।
নিজজন সঙ্গে গেলা শ্রীবাসের বাড়ী ॥ ৯৩ ॥

śoka chāṛi' hṛṣṭamane tabe gaurahari |
nijajana saṅge gelā śrībāsera bāṛī || 93 ||

shoka chhadi — leaving grief; hrishta-mane — with a glad heart; tabe gaurahari — then Gaurahari; nijajana sange — with His own; gela shrivasera badi — went to Srivasa's house

93Leaving grief behind, with a joyful heart Gaurahari
went with His own to Srivasa's house.

শ্রীনিবাস-হরিদাস-আদি যত জন ।
বসিয়া ঠাকুর কাছে নিরীখে বদন ॥ ৯৪ ॥

śrīnibāsa-haridāsa-ādi yata jana |
basiẏā ṭhākura kāche nirīkhe badana || 94 ||

shrinivasa-haridasa-adi yata jana — Srinivasa, Haridasa and all the others; basiya thakura kachhe — sitting near the Thakura; nirikhe vadana — gaze at His face

94Srinivasa, Haridasa and all the others
sit near the Thakura and gaze at His face.

হেনকালে মহাপ্রভু সভা-সন্নিধানে ।
কহয়ে অন্তর-কথা শুনে সর্বজনে ॥ ৯৫ ॥

henakāle mahāprabhu sabhā-sannidhāne |
kahaẏe antara-kathā śune sarbajane || 95 ||

henakale — then; mahaprabhu sabha-sannidhane — Mahaprabhu before the assembly; kahaye antara-katha — speaks the words of His heart; shune sarvajane — all listen

95Then Mahaprabhu, before the whole assembly,
speaks words from His heart, and all listen:

ধন জন যৌবন সকল অকারণ ।
না ভজিনু সত্যবস্তু কৃষ্ণের চরণ ॥ ৯৬ ॥

dhana jana yaubana sakala akāraṇa |
nā bhajinu satyabastu kṛṣṇera caraṇa || 96 ||

dhana jana yauvana — wealth, kin, youth; sakala akarana — all is in vain; na bhajinu — I did not serve; satya-vastu krishnera charana — the true reality, Krishna's feet

96"Wealth, kin, youth — all is in vain:
I have not served the true treasure — the feet of Krishna.

নিরন্তর দগধে সংসারে মোর হিয়া ।
না করিলুঁ কৃষ্ণকর্ম হেন দেহ পাঞা ॥ ৯৭ ॥

nirantara dagadhe saṃsāre mora hiẏā |
nā kariluṁ kṛṣṇakarma hena deha pāñā || 97 ||

nirantara dagadhe — ceaselessly burns; samsare mora hiya — My heart in samsara; na karilun krishna-karma — I did no work for Krishna; hena deha panna — having obtained such a body

97My heart burns ceaselessly in samsara:
having obtained such a body, I did no work for Krishna.

সংসারে দুর্লভ এই মানুষ-শরীর ।
কৃষ্ণ ভজিবারে কিবা পুরুষ নারীর ॥ ৯৮ ॥

saṃsāre durlabha ei mānuṣa-śarīra |
kṛṣṇa bhajibāre kibā puruṣa nārīra || 98 ||

samsare durlabha — rare in the world; ei manusha-sharira — this human body; krishna bhajibare — for serving Krishna; kiba purusha narira — what matter man or woman

98In this world the human body is rare;
and for serving Krishna, what does it matter — man or woman?

কৃষ্ণ না ভজিলে এই মিছা সব দেহ ।
পতি সুত পিতা মাতা মিছা সব গেহ ॥ ৯৯ ॥

kṛṣṇa nā bhajile ei michā saba deha |
pati suta pitā mātā michā saba geha || 99 ||

krishna na bhajile — if one does not serve Krishna; ei michha saba deha — this whole body is vain; pati suta pita mata — husband, son, father, mother; michha saba geha — all is vain, and the home

99If one does not serve Krishna, this whole body is in vain,
husband, son, father, mother — all is in vain, and the home.

মায়েরে ছাড়িয়া আমি যাব দিগন্তর ।
কহিল সভারে এই মরম-উত্তর ॥ ১০০ ॥

māẏere chāṛiẏā āmi yāba digantara |
kahila sabhāre ei marama-uttara || 100 ||

mayere chhadiya — leaving My mother; ami yaba digantara — I shall go to distant lands; kahila sabhare — He told all; ei marama-uttara — this word from the heart

100Leaving My mother, I shall go to distant lands" —
so He revealed to all His heart's word.4

সব-লোকে বোলে আমি বিরুদ্ধ করিয়ে ।
মুরারি কহয়ে ইহা শুনিতে মরিয়ে ॥ ১০১ ॥

saba-loke bole āmi biruddha kariẏe |
murāri kahaẏe ihā śunite mariẏe || 101 ||

saba-loke bole — all the people say; ami viruddha kariye — that I act wrongly; murari kahaye — Murari says; iha shunite mariye — on hearing this I die

101"All the people say that I act wrongly."
Murari says: "To hear this is death to me.

কেহ না বোলয়ে ইহা শুন মহাপ্রভু ।
আমরা ত কারো মুখে নাহি শুনি কভু ॥ ১০২ ॥

keha nā bolaẏe ihā śuna mahāprabhu |
āmarā ta kāro mukhe nāhi śuni kabhu || 102 ||

keha na bolaye iha — no one says this; shuna mahaprabhu — listen, Mahaprabhu; amara ta karo mukhe — we from anyone's lips; nahi shuni kabhu — have never heard

102No one says so, listen, Mahaprabhu:
we have never heard it from anyone's lips."

এ বোল শুনিঞা সেই গৌর ভগবান্ ।
মুরারি ধরিয়া দিল আলিঙ্গন-দান ॥ ১০৩ ॥

e bola śuniñā sei gaura bhagabān |
murāri dhariẏā dila āliṅgana-dāna || 103 ||

e bola shuninna — hearing this; sei gaura bhagavan — Gaura Bhagavan; murari dhariya — taking hold of Murari; dila alingana-dana — gave the gift of an embrace

103Hearing this, Gaura Bhagavan
embraced Murari.

মুরারি করিয়া কোলে সান্ধাইলা ঘরে ।
প্রভু-আলিঙ্গনে বৈদ্য আপনা পাসরে ॥ ১০৪ ॥

murāri kariẏā kole sāndhāilā ghare |
prabhu-āliṅgane baidya āpanā pāsare || 104 ||

murari kariya kole — holding Murari in His embrace; sandhaila ghare — He entered the house; prabhu-alingane — in the Lord's embrace; vaidya apana pasare — the vaidya forgot himself

104Embracing Murari, He went [with him] into the house;
in the Lord's embrace the vaidya forgot himself.

পুলকিত সব অঙ্গ আপাদমস্তক ।
পড়িলা ত প্রাচীন আছিল এক শ্লোক ॥ ১০৫ ॥

pulakita saba aṅga āpādamastaka |
paṛilā ta prācīna āchila eka śloka || 105 ||

pulakita saba anga — his whole body thrilled; apadamastaka — from foot to head; padila ta — he recited; prachina achhila eka shloka — an ancient verse there was

105His whole body thrilled from head to foot;
he recited an ancient verse:

ক্বাহং দরিদ্রঃ পাপীয়ান্ ক্ব কৃষ্ণঃ শ্রীনিকেতনঃ ।
ব্রহ্মবন্ধুরিতি স্মাহং বাহুভ্যাং পরিরম্ভিতঃ ॥ ১০৬ ॥

kbāhaṃ daridraḥ pāpīẏān kba kṛṣṇaḥ śrīniketanaḥ |
brahmabandhuriti smāhaṃ bāhubhyāṃ parirambhitaḥ || 106 ||

kva aham — where am I; daridrah — poor; papiyan — most sinful; kva krishnah — where is Krishna; shri-niketanah — the abode of Shri; brahma-bandhuh iti — [I,] a brahmana by birth only; sma aham — yet I; bahubhyam parirambhitah — was embraced with His arms

106"Where am I — a poor man, most sinful — and where is Krishna, the abode of Shri!
Yet me, a brahmana only by birth, He embraced with His arms."5

এ বোল শুনিঞা সে প্রকাশে ঠাকুরাল ।
কোটি রবি-কিরণ জিনিয়া উজিয়ার ॥ ১০৭ ॥

e bola śuniñā se prakāśe ṭhākurāla |
koṭi rabi-kiraṇa jiniẏā ujiẏāra || 107 ||

e bola shuninna — hearing this; se prakashe thakurala — He revealed His lordship; koti ravi-kirana jiniya — surpassing the rays of millions of suns; ujiyara — radiance

107Hearing this, He revealed His lordship —
a radiance surpassing the rays of millions of suns.

আসনে বসিয়া কহে বচন মধুর ।
এই আমি চিদানন্দ না ভাবিহ দূর ॥ ১০৮ ॥

āsane basiẏā kahe bacana madhura |
ei āmi cidānanda nā bhābiha dūra || 108 ||

asane basiya — sitting on His seat; kahe vachana madhura — speaks sweet words; ei ami chidananda — here I am, consciousness and bliss; na bhaviha dura — do not think [Me] far

108Sitting on His seat, He speaks sweet words:
"Here I am — consciousness and bliss; do not think I am far away."6

এ বোল শুনিঞা সভে আনন্দে বিহ্বল ।
পুলকে ভরিল সভার সব কলেবর ॥ ১০৯ ॥

e bola śuniñā sabhe ānande bihbala |
pulake bharila sabhāra saba kalebara || 109 ||

e bola shuninna — hearing this; sabhe anande vihvala — all were overwhelmed with bliss; pulake bharila — were filled with thrill; sabhara saba kalebara — the bodies of all

109Hearing this, all were overwhelmed with bliss,
the bodies of all were filled with thrill.

শ্রীবাসপণ্ডিত সেই উত্তম-আচার ।
গঙ্গাজলে অভিষেক করয়ে তাহার ॥ ১১০ ॥

śrībāsapaṇḍita sei uttama-ācāra |
gaṅgājale abhiṣeka karaẏe tāhāra || 110 ||

shrivasa-pandita sei — that Srivasa Pandita; uttama-achara — excellent in conduct; ganga-jale — with Ganga water; abhisheka karaye tahara — performs His bathing

110Srivasa Pandita, excellent in conduct,
bathes Him with the water of the Ganga.

অভিষেক করি' পূজা করি' যথাবিধি ।
তাহার পূজায় তুষ্ট হৈলা গুণনিধি ॥ ১১১ ॥

abhiṣeka kari' pūjā kari' yathābidhi |
tāhāra pūjāẏa tuṣṭa hailā guṇanidhi || 111 ||

abhisheka kari — performing the bathing; puja kari yathavidhi — worshipping according to rule; tahara pujaya — with his worship; tushta haila guna-nidhi — the Treasury of virtues was pleased

111He performed the bathing and worship according to rule,
and the Treasury of virtues was pleased with his worship.

আনন্দে সকল লোক হরিগুণ গায় ।
ভকত-বদন হেরি' নাচে গোরারায় ॥ ১১২ ॥

ānande sakala loka hariguṇa gāẏa |
bhakata-badana heri' nāce gorārāẏa || 112 ||

anande sakala loka — in joy all people; hari-guna gaya — sing Hari's qualities; bhakata-vadana heri — looking at the devotees' faces; nache gora-raya — Gora-raya dances

112In joy all the people sing of Hari's qualities;
looking at the faces of the devotees, Gora-raya dances.

নরহরি-পাদপদ্ম ধরি' শিরোপরি ।
কহয়ে লোচনদাস গৌরাঙ্গ-মাধুরী ॥ ১১৩ ॥

narahari-pādapadma dhari' śiropari |
kahaẏe locanadāsa gaurāṅga-mādhurī || 113 ||

narahari-pada-padma — the lotus feet of Narahari; dhari shiropari — holding on the head; kahaye lochana-dasa — Lochana Dasa speaks; gauranga-madhuri — of Gauranga's sweetness

113Placing on his head the lotus feet of Narahari,
Lochana Dasa speaks of the sweetness of Gauranga.

তার-পর-দিনে কথা অপূর্ব-কথন ।
সাবধানে শুন সভে কহিব এখন ॥ ১১৪ ॥

tāra-para-dine kathā apūrba-kathana |
sābadhāne śuna sabhe kahiba ekhana || 114 ||

tara-para-dine katha — the story of the following day; apurva-kathana — an unheard-of telling; savadhane shuna sabhe — all, listen attentively; kahiba ekhana — I shall tell now

114Hear an unheard-of story of the following day:
listen attentively — I shall tell it now.

শিখায়ে সকল লোকে লোক-শিক্ষাগুরু ।
করুণাসাগর প্রেমভক্তি-কল্পতরু ॥ ১১৫ ॥

śikhāẏe sakala loke loka-śikṣāguru |
karuṇāsāgara premabhakti-kalpataru || 115 ||

shikhaye sakala loke — teaches all people; loka-shiksha-guru — the Teacher of the world; karuna-sagara — the ocean of mercy; prema-bhakti-kalpataru — the wish-fulfilling tree of prema-bhakti

115The Teacher of the world teaches all people —
the ocean of mercy, the wish-fulfilling tree of prema-bhakti.

নিজজন বুঝাবারে করে যত কার্য ।
সংহতি করিয়া আদি অদ্বৈত-আচার্য ॥ ১১৬ ॥

nijajana bujhābāre kare yata kārya |
saṃhati kariẏā ādi adbaita-ācārya || 116 ||

nijajana bujhabare — to enlighten His own; kare yata karya — He does all His deeds; samhati kariya — taking along; adi advaita-acharya — Advaita Acharya and others

116All He does is to enlighten His own.
Taking with Him Advaita Acharya and the others —

শ্রীনিবাস হরিদাস মুরারি মুকুন্দ ।
গদাধর শুক্লাম্বর রাম আদি অন্ত ॥ ১১৭ ॥

śrīnibāsa haridāsa murāri mukunda |
gadādhara śuklāmbara rāma ādi anta || 117 ||

shrinivasa haridasa murari mukunda — Srinivasa, Haridasa, Murari, Mukunda; gadadhara shuklambara rama — Gadadhara, Shuklambara, Rama; adi anta — and the rest

117Srinivasa, Haridasa, Murari, Mukunda,
Gadadhara, Shuklambara, Rama and the rest,

নরহরি রঘুনন্দন শ্রীমুকুন্দদাস ।
বাসুঘোষ জগদানন্দ আদি সর্বদাস ॥ ১১৮ ॥

narahari raghunandana śrīmukundadāsa |
bāsughoṣa jagadānanda ādi sarbadāsa || 118 ||

narahari raghunandana shri-mukunda-dasa — Narahari, Raghunandana, Sri Mukunda Dasa; vasu-ghosha jagadananda — Vasu Ghosha, Jagadananda; adi sarva-dasa — and all the servants

118Narahari, Raghunandana, Sri Mukunda Dasa,
Vasu Ghosha, Jagadananda and all the servants —

যতেক ভকত সব সংহতি করিয়া ।
দেবালয়ে যায় প্রভু আনন্দিত হইয়া ॥ ১১৯ ॥

yateka bhakata saba saṃhati kariẏā |
debālaẏe yāẏa prabhu ānandita haiẏā || 119 ||

yateka bhakata saba — all the devotees; samhati kariya — taking along; devalaye yaya prabhu — the Lord goes to the temple; anandita haiya — joyfully

119taking all the devotees with Him,
the Lord joyfully goes to the temple.7

নেত-ধটী পরিধান কান্ধে ত কোদাল ।
করে সম্মার্জনী করি' সভার মিশাল ॥ ১২০ ॥

neta-dhaṭī paridhāna kāndhe ta kodāla |
kare sammārjanī kari' sabhāra miśāla || 120 ||

neta-dhati paridhana — wearing a loincloth; kandhe ta kodala — a hoe on His shoulder; kare sammarjani kari — with a broom in hand; sabhara mishala — together with all

120He wears a loincloth, a hoe on His shoulder,
a broom in His hand, and all are together with Him.

সঙ্গের যতেক জন ধরে সেই বেশ ।
হাথে ঝাঁটা কান্ধে কোদাল উভ বান্ধে কেশ ॥ ১২১ ॥

saṅgera yateka jana dhare sei beśa |
hāthe jhāṁṭā kāndhe kodāla ubha bāndhe keśa || 121 ||

sangera yateka jana — all His companions; dhare sei besha — wear the same dress; hathe jhanta — brooms in hand; kandhe kodala — hoes on the shoulder; ubha bandhe kesha — tie their hair up high

121All His companions wear the same dress:
brooms in their hands, hoes on their shoulders, their hair tied up high.

দেবালয়-মার্জনা করিতে যায় প্রভু ।
হেন অদ্ভুত কথা নাহি শুনি কভু ॥ ১২২ ॥

debālaẏa-mārjanā karite yāẏa prabhu |
hena adbhuta kathā nāhi śuni kabhu || 122 ||

devalaya-marjana karite — to clean the temple; yaya prabhu — the Lord goes; hena adbhuta katha — such a wondrous story; nahi shuni kabhu — I have never heard

122The Lord goes to clean the temple —
never have I heard such a wondrous story.

কৃষ্ণের হড্ডিপ হইয়া বুলে দ্বারে দ্বারে ।
সকল বৈষ্ণব মেলি' সম্মার্জনা করে ॥ ১২৩ ॥

kṛṣṇera haḍḍipa haiẏā bule dbāre dbāre |
sakala baiṣṇaba meli' sammārjanā kare || 123 ||

krishnera haddipa haiya — becoming Krishna's sweeper; bule dvare dvare — He goes from door to door; sakala vaishnava meli — all the Vaishnavas together; sammarjana kare — sweep

123Becoming Krishna's sweeper, He goes from door to door;
all the Vaishnavas together sweep.8

এইমতে লোক-শিক্ষা করায়ে ঠাকুর ।
ভজহ সকল লোক যে হও চতুর ॥ ১২৪ ॥

eimate loka-śikṣā karāẏe ṭhākura |
bhajaha sakala loka ye hao catura || 124 ||

ei-mate — thus; loka-shiksha karaye thakura — the Thakura teaches the people; bhajaha sakala loka — serve, all people; ye hao chatura — whoever is wise

124Thus the Thakura teaches the people:
serve [Him], all people, whoever is wise!

প্রেমভক্তি-দাতা আর নাহি কোন জন ।
জানিঞা ভজহ শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ-চরণ ॥ ১২৫ ॥

premabhakti-dātā āra nāhi kona jana |
jāniñā bhajaha śrīgaurāṅga-caraṇa || 125 ||

prema-bhakti-data — Giver of prema-bhakti; ara nahi kona jana — there is no other; janinna — knowing this; bhajaha shri-gauranga-charana — serve the feet of Sri Gauranga

125There is no other Giver of prema-bhakti —
knowing this, serve the feet of Sri Gauranga.

যুগে যুগে কত কত অবতার আছে ।
ভজিলে সে ভজে তার অনুরূপ আছে ॥ ১২৬ ॥

yuge yuge kata kata abatāra āche |
bhajile se bhaje tāra anurūpa āche || 126 ||

yuge yuge — age after age; kata kata avatara achhe — there are so many avataras; bhajile se bhaje — they serve when served; tara anurupa achhe — in like measure

126In age after age come so many avataras —
and they return service for service in like measure.

আর কেহো নাহি করে হেন ঠাকুরাল ।
ভক্তি বুঝাবারে করে কান্ধে ত কোদাল ॥ ১২৭ ॥

āra keho nāhi kare hena ṭhākurāla |
bhakti bujhābāre kare kāndhe ta kodāla || 127 ||

ara keho nahi kare — no one else shows; hena thakurala — such lordship; bhakti bujhabare — to teach bhakti; kare kandhe ta kodala — He puts a hoe on His shoulder

127No one else has shown such lordship:
to teach bhakti He puts a hoe on His shoulder.

না ভজিলে ভজে হেন জন কোন যুগে ।
ঘরে ঘরে বুলে কেবা নিজভক্তি মাগে ॥ ১২৮ ॥

nā bhajile bhaje hena jana kona yuge |
ghare ghare bule kebā nijabhakti māge || 128 ||

na bhajile bhaje — who serves even when not served; hena jana kona yuge — such a one in what age; ghare ghare bule — goes from house to house; keba nija-bhakti mage — who begs [acceptance of] devotion to himself

128In what age was there one who serves those who do not serve Him,
who goes from house to house begging [them to accept] devotion to Himself?

ভজিলে সে ভজে সেই বড়ই ঠাকুর ।
ভক্তে সে কহয়ে ইহা আনে কহে দূর ॥ ১২৯ ॥

bhajile se bhaje sei baṛai ṭhākura |
bhakte se kahaẏe ihā āne kahe dūra || 129 ||

bhajile se bhaje — who serves in return when served; sei badai thakura — he is [already] a great lord; bhakte se kahaye iha — the devotees say this; ane kahe dura — others say: far away

129"He who returns service for service is already a great lord" —
so say the devotees; and others say [God] is far away.9

বিচার না করে পাত্রাপাত্র কোন দেশে ।
বৃন্দাবন-ধন দিয়া সভারে সন্তোষে ॥ ১৩০ ॥

bicāra nā kare pātrāpātra kona deśe |
bṛndābana-dhana diẏā sabhāre santoṣe || 130 ||

The Leper's Release from Sin and the Bhava of Baladeva

Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati. One day, when Sriman Mahaprabhu was walking with the devotees, absorbed in prema, a brahmana afflicted with leprosy on that road appealed to Sriman Mahaprabhu for his deliverance. Sriman Mahaprabhu at first rejected him as an offender against a Vaishnava, then told him to beg Srivasa Pandita's forgiveness for his offence, and at last, freeing him from the offence against the Vaishnava, bestowed prema on him. A certain brahmana wished to see Gaurasundara's dancing, but the devotees of Gaura headed by Srivasa did not admit him, and his desire was not fulfilled; so one day, seeing Sriman Mahaprabhu bathing in the Ganga, he angrily cursed Him: "May Your worldly happiness be destroyed!" Sriman Mahaprabhu accepted the brahmana's curse with joy. Then the brahmana came to his senses and in fear began to praise Sriman Mahaprabhu, and Sriman Mahaprabhu consoled him, revealing that the brahmana's curse was what He Himself desired. Then are described wondrous pastimes: Sriman Mahaprabhu in the bhava of Balarama cries out "Give Me honey!"; with the devotees, performing kirtana, He goes to the house of Sri Advaita Acharya; the next day, when He has fainted in the bhava of Baladeva, Gadadhara comes and He restrains His bhava; the devotees headed by Acharyaratna arrive; Srivasa and the other devotees see Sriman Mahaprabhu in the form of Baladeva; He goes with the devotees to bathe in the Ganga, and so on.11

iha jani — knowing this; gela prabhu shrivasa-alaya — the Lord went to Srivasa's house; basiya — sitting down; sakala katha kahe mahashaya — the Great Soul tells everything

26Knowing this, the Lord went to Srivasa's house
and, sitting down, the Great Soul tells him everything:

পথেতে দেখিল কুষ্ঠব্যাধি একজন ।
অপরাধ ভুঞ্জিব সে অনেক জনম ॥ ২৭ ॥

pathete dekhila kuṣṭhabyādhi ekajana |
aparādha bhuñjiba se aneka janama || 27 ||

pathete dekhila — on the road [I] saw; kushtha-vyadhi ekajana — a leper; aparadha bhunjiba se — he will suffer for his offence; aneka janama — many births

27"On the road I saw a leper:
for his offence he will suffer many births.

তোর অপরাধে সে গলিত সর্বদেহ ।
তাহারে দেখিয়া মোর না উঠিল স্নেহ ॥ ২৮ ॥

tora aparādhe se galita sarbadeha |
tāhāre dekhiẏā mora nā uṭhila sneha || 28 ||

tora aparadhe — for the offence against you; se galita sarva-deha — his whole body is rotting; tahare dekhiya — seeing him; mora na uthila sneha — no affection arose in Me

28For his offence against you his whole body is rotting,
and seeing him, I felt no pity for him.

পরিত্রাণ কর বলি' ডাকে কুষ্ঠব্যাধি ।
কে করিবে পরিত্রাণ তোর অপরাধী ॥ ২৯ ॥

paritrāṇa kara bali' ḍāke kuṣṭhabyādhi |
ke karibe paritrāṇa tora aparādhī || 29 ||

paritrana kara bali — saying "deliver me"; dake kushtha-vyadhi — the leper cries; ke karibe paritrana — who will deliver; tora aparadhi — one who offended you

29'Deliver me!' the leper cries;
but who will deliver one who has offended you?

যদি বা আপনে তুমি দয়া-দিঠে চায় ।
তবে সে নিস্তারে পাপী তোমার কৃপায় ॥ ৩০ ॥

yadi bā āpane tumi daẏā-diṭhe cāẏa |
tabe se nistāre pāpī tomāra kṛpāẏa || 30 ||

yadi ba apane tumi — only if you yourself; daya-dithe chaya — look with a kind eye; tabe se nistare papi — then the sinner is delivered; tomara kripaya — by your mercy

30Only if you yourself look on him with kindness
will the sinner be delivered by your mercy."

এ বোল শুনিঞা তবে শ্রীবাসপণ্ডিত ।
হাসিতে লাগিল প্রভুর শুনিঞা চরিত ॥ ৩১ ॥

e bola śuniñā tabe śrībāsapaṇḍita |
hāsite lāgila prabhura śuniñā carita || 31 ||

e bola shuninna — hearing this; tabe shrivasa-pandita — then Srivasa Pandita; hasite lagila — began to laugh; prabhura shuninna charita — hearing of the Lord's conduct

31Hearing this, Srivasa Pandita
began to laugh, hearing of the Lord's conduct:

মুঞি মহা-অধমাধম মোরে হেন বোল ।
মোর ছলে পাতকীর পরিত্রাণ কর ॥ ৩২ ॥

muñi mahā-adhamādhama more hena bola |
mora chale pātakīra paritrāṇa kara || 32 ||

munni maha-adhamadhama — I am the lowest of the low; more hena bola — to me You say such things; mora chhale — using me as a pretext; patakira paritrana kara — You deliver the sinner

32"I am the lowest of the low — and You say such things to me!
Using me as a pretext, You deliver the sinner.

মোর ঠাঞি তার দোষ ঘুচিল সর্বথা ।
প্রসন্ন হইলুঁ আমি ঘুচাও তার ব্যথা ॥ ৩৩ ॥

mora ṭhāñi tāra doṣa ghucila sarbathā |
prasanna hailuṁ āmi ghucāo tāra byathā || 33 ||

mora thanni — towards me; tara dosha ghuchila sarvatha — his fault has entirely gone; prasanna hailun ami — I am pleased; ghuchao tara vyatha — remove his suffering

33His fault towards me is entirely gone;
I am pleased — relieve him of his suffering."

এ বোল শুনিয়া প্রভু করে হরি-নাদ ।
নিস্তারিল কুষ্ঠব্যাধি হেন পরসাদ ॥ ৩৪ ॥

e bola śuniẏā prabhu kare hari-nāda |
nistārila kuṣṭhabyādhi hena parasāda || 34 ||

e bola shuniya — hearing this; prabhu kare hari-nada — the Lord cries aloud "Hari"; nistarila kushtha-vyadhi — the leper was delivered; hena parasada — such was the grace

34Hearing this, the Lord cried aloud "Hari!" —
and the leper was delivered: such [was] the grace.

তথা গঙ্গাতীরে সেইক্ষণে কুষ্ঠব্যাধি ।
পাইল শ্রীবাস-কৃপা পরম-ঔষধি ॥ ৩৫ ॥

tathā gaṅgātīre seikṣaṇe kuṣṭhabyādhi |
pāila śrībāsa-kṛpā parama-auṣadhi || 35 ||

tatha gangatire — there on the bank of the Ganga; sei-kshane kushtha-vyadhi — that moment the leper; paila shrivasa-kripa — received Srivasa's mercy; parama-aushadhi — the supreme medicine

35There, on the bank of the Ganga, that very moment the leper
received the supreme medicine — the mercy of Srivasa.14

দিব্যদেহ সেইক্ষণে হইল তাহার ।
গৌরাঙ্গ বলিয়া ধায় আরতি-বিথার ॥ ৩৬ ॥

dibyadeha seikṣaṇe haila tāhāra |
gaurāṅga baliẏā dhāẏa ārati-bithāra || 36 ||

divya-deha — a divine body; sei-kshane haila tahara — became his that moment; gauranga baliya dhaya — crying "Gauranga" he runs; arati-vithara — overwhelmed with longing

36That very moment his body became divine;
crying "Gauranga!", he runs, overcome with longing:

মহাপ্রেমে মত্ত হৈয়া করয়ে হুঙ্কার ।
ক্ষণে মূর্ছা যায় ক্ষণে প্রলাপ অপার ॥ ৩৬+১ ॥

mahāpreme matta haiẏā karaẏe huṅkāra |
kṣaṇe mūrchā yāẏa kṣaṇe pralāpa apāra || 36+1 ||

maha-preme matta haiya — intoxicated with great prema; karaye hunkara — gives thunderous cries; kshane murchha yaya — now swoons; kshane pralapa apara — now raves without end

36+1Intoxicated with great prema, he gives thunderous cries:
now he swoons, now he raves without end15.

কোথা গেলা গৌরচন্দ্র অন্তরের চান্দ ।
এমন কে তারে ভবব্যাধি মহা-আন্ধ ॥ ৩৭ ॥

kothā gelā gauracandra antarera cānda |
emana ke tāre bhababyādhi mahā-āndha || 37 ||

kotha gela gaurachandra — where has Gaurachandra gone; antarera chanda — the moon of my heart; emana ke tare — who else so delivers; bhava-vyadhi maha-andha — [from] the disease of existence, the great blindness

37"Where has Gaurachandra gone, the moon of my heart?
Who else so frees one from the great blindness — the disease of existence?"

এথা গৌরচন্দ্র শ্রীনিবাস-ঘর হৈতে ।
কুষ্ঠব্যাধি দেখিবারে চলিলা তুরিতে ॥ ৩৮ ॥

ethā gauracandra śrīnibāsa-ghara haite |
kuṣṭhabyādhi dekhibāre calilā turite || 38 ||

etha gaurachandra — meanwhile Gaurachandra; shrinivasa-ghara haite — from Srinivasa's house; kushtha-vyadhi dekhibare — to see the leper; chalila turite — set out quickly

38Meanwhile Gaurachandra left Srinivasa's house
and hurried to see the leper.

পথে কুষ্ঠব্যাধি সনে হৈল দরশন ।
ধরিয়া পড়িলা ভূমি প্রভুর চরণ ॥ ৩৯ ॥

pathe kuṣṭhabyādhi sane haila daraśana |
dhariẏā paṛilā bhūmi prabhura caraṇa || 39 ||

pathe — on the road; kushtha-vyadhi sane haila darashana — He met the leper; dhariya — clasping; padila bhumi — he fell on the ground; prabhura charana — the Lord's feet

39On the road they met,
and [he], clasping the Lord's feet, fell to the ground.

তুলিয়া তাহারে প্রভু করিল আলিঙ্গনে ।
ব্রহ্মার দুর্লভ প্রেম দিলা সেইক্ষণে ॥ ৪০ ॥

tuliẏā tāhāre prabhu karila āliṅgane |
brahmāra durlabha prema dilā seikṣaṇe || 40 ||

tuliya tahare — raising him; prabhu karila alingane — the Lord embraced him; brahmara durlabha prema — prema rare even for Brahma; dila sei-kshane — He gave that moment

40Raising him, the Lord embraced him
and that very moment gave him prema, hard even for Brahma to obtain.

হাসে কান্দে নাচে গায় গড়াগড়ি যায় ।
গদাধর-বন্ধু বলি' নাচিয়া বেড়ায় ॥ ৪১ ॥

hāse kānde nāce gāẏa gaṛāgaṛi yāẏa |
gadādhara-bandhu bali' nāciẏā beṛāẏa || 41 ||

hase kande nache gaya — he laughs, weeps, dances, sings; gadagadi yaya — rolls on the ground; gadadhara-bandhu bali — crying "Friend of Gadadhara"; nachiya bedaya — goes about dancing

41He laughs, weeps, dances, sings, rolls on the ground,
whirls about in dance, crying: "Friend of Gadadhara!"16

সব ভক্ত আনন্দিত হৈল তা দেখিয়া ।
চমৎকার হৈল দেখি' সকল নদিয়া ॥ ৪২ ॥

saba bhakta ānandita haila tā dekhiẏā |
camatkāra haila dekhi' sakala nadiẏā || 42 ||

saba bhakta anandita haila — all the devotees rejoiced; ta dekhiya — seeing this; chamatkara haila — was amazed; dekhi sakala nadiya — seeing it, all Nadia

42Seeing this, all the devotees rejoiced,
and all Nadia, seeing it, was amazed.

শুন সর্বজন বিশ্বম্ভরের চরিত ।
শুনিলে সে প্রেমভক্তি পাইবে তুরিত ॥ ৪৩ ॥

śuna sarbajana biśbambharera carita |
śunile se premabhakti pāibe turita || 43 ||

shuna sarvajana — hear, all; vishvambharera charita — of Vishvambhara's deeds; shunile se — on hearing; prema-bhakti paibe turita — you will soon obtain prema-bhakti

43Hear, all of you, of Vishvambhara's deeds:
hearing of them, you will soon obtain prema-bhakti.

তবে সেই মহাপ্রভু অন্তর-উল্লাস ।
নাচে সেই বিপ্র-দেহে প্রেমার প্রকাশ ॥ ৪৩+১ ॥

tabe sei mahāprabhu antara-ullāsa |
nāce sei bipra-dehe premāra prakāśa || 43+1 ||

tabe sei mahaprabhu — then Mahaprabhu; antara-ullasa — rejoicing at heart; nache — dances; sei vipra-dehe — in the body of that brahmana; premara prakasha — the manifestation of prema

43+1Then Mahaprabhu, rejoicing at heart,
dances — and prema became manifest in the brahmana's body17.

দেখিয়া ত মহাপ্রভু করে হরিনাদ ।
নিস্তারিল কুষ্ঠব্যাধি কৈল পরসাদ ॥ ৪৩+২ ॥

dekhiẏā ta mahāprabhu kare harināda |
nistārila kuṣṭhabyādhi kaila parasāda || 43+2 ||

dekhiya ta — seeing this; mahaprabhu kare hari-nada — Mahaprabhu loudly cries "Hari"; nistarila kushthavyadhi — delivered the leper; kaila parasada — showed grace

43+2Seeing this, Mahaprabhu loudly cries "Hari!":
He delivered the leper, He showed him grace.

অতি অপরূপ এই নদিয়া-প্রকাশ ।
শুনিতে আনন্দে ভোরা এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৪৪ ॥

ati aparūpa ei nadiẏā-prakāśa |
śunite ānande bhorā e locanadāsa || 44 ||

ati aparupa — most wondrous; ei nadiya-prakasha — this manifestation in Nadia; shunite — on hearing; anande bhora — lost in joy; e lochana-dasa — this Lochana Dasa

44Most wondrous is this manifestation in Nadia —
hearing of it, Lochana Dasa is lost in joy.

✦

Notes

  1. The text has "a brahmana" (so also the 1983 edition); in Bhaktisiddhanta's summary (en/31, at the head of the section "Wondrous Pastimes of Mahaprabhu in the Bhava of Bhagavan") and in Murari (2.11.21) it is a brahmana woman. The Lord, playing the role of a devotee, grieves at having received an honour befitting the Lord. Vv. 64–79 — cf. Murari 2.11.19–25.
  2. V. 77+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives it in a footnote as an additional reading (in another form: "Gadadhara and Narahari weep, holding the Lord; Vasudeva and Jagadananda weep, gazing at the Lord").
  3. Vv. 80–92 — cf. Murari 2.12.1–4. Vijaya is probably Vijaya Dasa, a devotee of Navadvipa and copyist of books.
  4. The Lord is already thinking of sannyasa. Vv. 93–102 — cf. Murari 2.12.5–8.
  5. Bhagavata 10.81.16 — the words of the poor brahmana Sudama whom Krishna embraced; Murari applies them to himself. In the edition the verse is followed by Bhaktisiddhanta's anvaya and translation: "Where am I, a sinful pauper, and where is Krishnachandra, full of all opulence! Only because I am the lowest of brahmanas did Bhagavan embrace me with both arms." Cf. Murari 2.12.9–11.
  6. Literally "I am Chidananda": the Lord's body is not material — it is consciousness and bliss (cf. Murari 2.12.13: "this body is the highest concentration of being and consciousness"). Vv. 107–111 — cf. Murari 2.12.12–15.
  7. Vv. 114–123 — cf. Murari 2.13 (the Lord and the devotees clean the temple). Narahari, Raghunandana and Mukunda Dasa in this list appear only in Lochana Dasa (cf. en/30, note 7); "Rama" is Sri Rama Pandita, Srivasa's brother.
  8. A haddipa is a sweeper of the lowest caste of scavengers. The Lord Himself takes on the lowliest service, teaching humility and service to the Deity; cf. the cleaning of the Gundicha temple (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Madhya 12).
  9. Vv. 126–133: the other avataras return service for service (cf. Gita 4.11: "as they surrender to Me, so I reciprocate"), while Gaura Himself goes from house to house offering prema even to those who do not serve Him.
  10. V. 133+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks it).
  11. The summary covers both this section (the leper, vv. 1–44; the brahmana's curse, vv. 45–69) and the pastimes in the bhava of Balarama, which in the text of the edition already form the next section. The OCR of the summary is garbled in places; gaps are filled from the table of contents in the edition's preface. Cf. Murari 2.13; Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 17. In the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Adi 17) this is the brahmana Gopala Chapala, who slandered Srivasa and was struck with leprosy; the Lord refused him and later told him to beg Srivasa's forgiveness.
  12. Vv. 11–19 speak of the gravity of offence against a Vaishnava (vaishnava-aparadha): the Lord does not forgive it Himself until the offended Vaishnava forgives. The words "the Vaishnava is My life within" convey the teaching that the devotee is dearer to the Lord than His own body (cf. Bhagavata 9.4.68: "the sadhus are My heart, and I am the heart of the sadhus").
  13. The Lord is the independent Master, but of His own will He submits to the love of His devotees (bhakta-adhina); therefore He places the Vaishnava's forgiveness above His own.
  14. In the 1983 edition this story is given in a different redaction (the 1903 edition agrees with Bhaktisiddhanta; we follow Bhaktisiddhanta's edition). Instead of vv. 20–24 it has: "Hearing this, the brahmana was filled with anguish and, falling to the ground, began to plead piteously: 'Glory, glory to Mahaprabhu, be merciful to me! The Vedas call You the Purifier of the fallen. If You bear the name Purifier of the fallen, You will surely deliver me. How many great sinners You have delivered — deliver me too, O lotus-eyed One! There is no sinner in the three worlds equal to me; I am suffering — free [me] from leprosy.'" V. 25 there reads: "Then compassion awoke in the Lord's heart, yet He is subject to the Vaishnavas, not independent." Instead of v. 34: "The Lord says: 'Srinivasa, listen to Me: take everyone and go to where the leper is.' Then all went there together joyfully and sprinkled him with the water of Srivasa's feet. As soon as the drops of that water touched his body, his body shone like gold and the disease vanished. Then his heart was filled with great bliss, and he joyfully began to dance, crying 'Hari, Hari!'" From v. 35 on the two redactions agree. The sense is the same: an offence against a Vaishnava is removed only by the mercy of the offended Vaishnava himself (the water of his feet).
  15. V. 36+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks it).
  16. "Friend of Gadadhara" — a name of Gaura, inseparable from Gadadhara Pandita (in the Gaudiya Vaishnava understanding, Radha; en/25, note 7).
  17. Vv. 43+1 — 43+2 are found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks them).
